up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649964. For each record, include the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and the standard activity details (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units). Do not filter or restrict rows; include all available activity rows for that assay.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649964';
